words.meaning: A sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past.
words.sentence1: Looking through the old family photo album filled him with deep nostalgia. (Looking through the old family photo album filled him with deep nostalgia.)
words.sentence2: The smell of baking bread brought back a sudden wave of childhood nostalgia. (The smell of baking bread brought back a sudden wave of childhood nostalgia.)

words.meaning: A gentle feeling of affection, warmth, or tenderness.
words.sentence1: Sintio una profunda ternura al ver al pequeno cachorro dormir. (He felt a deep tenderness upon seeing the little puppy sleep.)
words.sentence2: Ella recordaba los consejos de su abuela con inmensa ternura. (She remembered her grandmother's advice with immense tenderness.)

words.meaning: A state of wonder, awe, or being pleasantly captivated.
words.sentence1: Les yeux des enfants brillaient d'emerveillement devant le ciel etoile. (The children's eyes shone with wonder before the starry sky.)
words.sentence2: Ce voyage a travers les montagnes a suscite un profond emerveillement en elle. (This journey across the mountains sparked a deep wonder within her.)

words.meaning: An intense, wistful yearning or deep emotional longing.
words.sentence1: Eine tiefe Sehnsucht nach seiner Heimat erfuellte sein Herz auf der Reise. (A deep yearning for his homeland filled his heart during the journey.)
words.sentence2: Sie fuehlte eine stille Sehnsucht nach den unbeschwerten Tagen ihrer Kindheit. (She felt a quiet longing for the carefree days of her childhood.)

words.meaning: Being deeply moved or emotionally touched to the heart.
words.sentence1: Sono utsukushii ensou o kiite kokoro kara kandou shimashita. (Listening to that beautiful musical performance, I was deeply moved from the heart.)
words.sentence2: Kanojo no yuuki aru supichi wa kankyaku ni ookina kandou o ataeta. (Her courageous speech brought great emotional stirring to the audience.)

words.meaning: A pensive, bittersweet feeling of sadness or contemplation.
words.sentence1: Una dolce malinconia lo avvolse mentre ascoltava quella vecchia melodia. (A sweet melancholy enveloped him as he listened to that old melody.)
words.sentence2: Il cielo grigio d'autunno portava sempre un senso di malinconia nel borgo. (The gray autumn sky always brought a sense of melancholy to the village.)

words.meaning: A feeling of deep joy, delight, or gladness.
words.sentence1: Ta de lian shang yangyi zhe shengli hou de xiyue. (His face beamed with joy after the victory.)
words.sentence2: Xinsheng er de daolai gei zhege jiating dailai le wuxian de xiyue. (The arrival of the newborn brought boundless joy to this family.)

words.meaning: A heartfelt longing, yearning, or missing of someone or somewhere.
words.sentence1: Gohyang e daehan geurium i bammada maeumeul gadeuk chaewotda. (Longing for home filled the heart every night.)
words.sentence2: Geunyeoneun oraejeon tteonan chingu e daehan gipeun geurium eul neukkyeotda. (She felt a deep yearning for a friend who had left long ago.)

words.meaning: Deep romantic love, affection, or emotional passion.
words.sentence1: Snaeha roboh puok-ke ban reuk-chamroen tam pel-velea. (Their love grew stronger over time.)
words.sentence2: Neang ban samdaeng snaeha yang chrok-chrou champoh krusa roboh neang. (She expressed deep heartfelt love toward her family.)

words.meaning: A feeling of deep sorrow, heartbreak, or grief.
words.sentence1: Daar was groot hartseer in die dorp na die tragiese gebeurtenis. (There was great sorrow in the town after the tragic event.)
words.sentence2: Sy kon die hartseer in haar oe nie langer verberg nie. (She could no longer hide the grief in her eyes.)
